items.what: REF pays referenced invoices with no customer, entity or dispute check
Manual override only sets the customer; REF still pays the referenced invoice
Ambiguous payer names resolve to an arbitrary customer (dropDuplicates)
The 'FIFO' step pays the largest open balances first, not the oldest
Receipts are processed in value-date order against shared balances; earlier receipts can consume referenced invoices
EXACT/FIFO search the customer pool across legal entities
TOL is reassigned from 0.5 to 5.0 in C29
MAX_WO is declared but never enforced
Negative receipts, unknown bank accounts and credit notes are dropped without a count
A missing FX rate leaves the USD amount null and the receipt can vanish
Checks only print and do not stop the run; exit is always ok
Rounding differences are plugged into the last line, so the recon passes by construction
notify_ar and log_run run even in dry runs
Tables are overwritten each run (history and other entities lost)
get_gl_map, notify_ar, log_run come from %run ../shared/fin_utils
Global mutable bal makes the notebook order-dependent and not re-runnable cell by cell
Value-date FX is computed but unused (commented out); latest rate is used
Dead code: v2 matching, fuzzy matching, alloc_by_aging
Suffix stripping is substring-based and can corrupt names
Disputed invoices are skipped by EXACT/FIFO but can still be paid by REF
toPandas and row loops on the driver limit scale
rcpt_no_dt counts null dates after they were already filtered out
Excluded customers are hard-coded without explanation
Value dates parse yyyy-MM-dd or dd/MM/yyyy only
Aging snapshot is appended, so re-runs duplicate rows
The SQL cells read the real table, so in a dry run they show the previous run
